body: Founder asked to ensure full process sync across everything touched this session. Audited every running binary's build mtime against its source's git HEAD (IDUNA, all FatBaby prebuilt binaries, shankpit-460's server) -- most were already current (the apparent gaps were changelog-only or docs-only commits after the relevant code build, not real drift). Found one genuine gap: eps-reconciler's reconcile() function had the exact same full-history-replay-via-paged-ReadFrom pattern as the 4 instances already fixed this session (signalapi, newssite, entity-graph, processor) -- the 5th confirmed instance of this bug class. Lower poll frequency (6h vs 15-30s) kept it below the threshold that caused a visible incident, but it paid the same O(n^2) cost every single run. Migrated to eventstore.Scan; live-verified 81s -> 26s for the same reconcile scan (var/logs/eps-reconciler.log timestamps, old run 05:26:49->05:28:10 vs new run 09:53:04->09:53:30). go test ./... green. PRRJECT_FATBABY commit 84b7148.
title: Full process sync audit: 5th replay-fragility instance found+fixed in eps-reconciler
